decision_rules.label: DIRECT_IDENTITY_OVERLAP
decision_rules.rule: Same repository and upstream PR/task identity as an already reviewed or exposed Development/Train task.

decision_rules.label: SAME_TASK_FAMILY
decision_rules.rule: Available Development/Train metadata documents the same underlying defect or behavioral contract in the same component; changed-path overlap corroborates but does not alone establish family identity.

decision_rules.label: POSSIBLE_FAMILY_OVERLAP
decision_rules.rule: Metadata suggests a shared parser/tool-call contract or subsystem, but evidence is insufficient to conclude the same defect family.

decision_rules.label: NO_PRIOR_FAMILY_OVERLAP_FOUND
decision_rules.rule: No direct identity or same-family match is found among the frozen Development/Train metadata; this does not establish public-pretraining independence.

decision_rules.label: INDETERMINATE
decision_rules.rule: Frozen prior metadata is incomplete or lacks enough issue/path detail to apply the other criteria.
